  use Application

  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      {Bandit, scheme: :http, plug: Catalog.Router, port: 4001, ip: {127, 0, 0, 1}}

defmodule Catalog.Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  forward "/api/json", to: AshJsonApi.Plug, init_opts: [domain: Catalog.Library]

  get "/api/json/reports/shelf_summary" do
    conn = fetch_query_params(conn)
    shelf = conn.query_params["shelf"]

    if is_nil(shelf) do
      render_error(conn, 400, "required", "/data/attributes/shelf", "Missing shelf parameter")
    else
      books = Ash.read!(Catalog.Library.Book, filter: [shelf: shelf])
      book_count = length(books)
      review_count = Enum.reduce(books, 0, fn b, acc -> acc + length(b.reviews) end)
      total_price = Enum.reduce(books, 0, fn b, acc -> acc + b.price_cents end)

      render_json(conn, 200, %{
        result: %{
          shelf: shelf,
          book_count: book_count,
          review_count: review_count,
          total_price_cents: total_price
        }
      })
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "Not Found")
  end

  defp render_json(conn, status, data) do
    conn
    |> put_resp_content_type("application/vnd.api+json")
    |> send_resp(status, Jason.encode!(data))
  end

  defp render_error(conn, status, code, pointer, detail) do
    render_json(conn, status, %{
      errors: [
        %{
          id: Ecto.UUID.generate(),
          status: to_string(status),
          code: code,
          title: get_title(code),
          detail: detail,
          source: %{pointer: pointer}
        }
      ]
    })
  end

  defp get_title("required"), do: "Required attribute missing"
  defp get_title("invalid_attribute"), do: "Invalid attribute"
  defp get_title(_), do: "Error"
end
